item.description: ## New Features - Codex now sends tool updates incrementally by default on Google Cloud Vertex AI. To opt out, set incremental_tools_legacy_gcp = false under [features] in config.toml. (#60617, #60848) ## Changelog Full Changelog: https://github.com/openai/codex/compare/rust-v0.167.1...rust-v0.167.2

## New Features - Open the agent command center with codex agents --no-daemon. The command center and session picker now mark unread results (#58238, #58239, #58263, #58264). - Switch between connected backends from the terminal session picker and keep your drafts when switching (#58280, #58457). - Preview local image attachments while composing on supported terminals, and open viewed local images from clickable transcript paths (#58261, #58446). - Find API key and cloud provider options under “Sign in another way.” Enable gcp_setup_wizard to set up Google Cloud Vertex AI with Application Default Credentials or a credential file (#57857, #58427). - Opt into macOS or Windows system proxy settings from /experimental (#58157). - Expand patch details directly in the transcript while an approval prompt is open (#58281). ## Bug Fixes - Saved chats stay visible after you switch model providers. If a chat can’t resume, you can read its transcript and prepare an editable prompt to continue in a new chat (#58202). - Ctrl+L clears the terminal display while keeping earlier messages available through Ctrl+T (#58266). - Deleting text that exposes a leading ! keeps an ordinary draft in chat mode (#58412). - Network approval prompts close when their requests end. Concurrent requests to the same endpoint prompt one at a time (#58350, #58351). - Long realtime V3 conversations save completed speech to chat history as the transcript grows (#58221). - Automatic context compaction now accounts for retained output from failed responses and responses with missing token usage data (#58404). ## Documentation - The app-server README covers managed network constraints under [permissions.network] and prompt-user command rules that require fresh human approval (#58045, #58182). - The openai-docs skill recommends the documented replacement when migrating away from a deprecated model (#58134). ## Chores - DotSlash manifests now reference the Cargo packages shipped with the release (#58717, #58757). - Linux musl builds use fewer allocator arenas to reduce idle memory after conversations unload (#58399). ## Changelog Full Changelog: https://github.com/openai/codex/compare/rust-v0.166.0...rust-v0.167.0 - item.description: Mirror of the unmodified libcap 2.75 source archive used to build Bubblewrap for Codex's Linux musl packages. - Upstream archive - SHA-256 for libcap-2.75.tar.xz is de4e7e064c9ba451d5234dd46e897d7c71c96a9ebf9a0c445bc04f4742d83632.

## New Features - Added keyboard-driven transcript selection with word, line, and page motions, integrated search, and configurable shortcuts. (#57221, #57222, #57223, #57224) - Rendered Markdown consistently in async questions, choices, answers, and transcript replies. (#57259, #57292) - Added GPT-6.1 Terra to the bundled, Vertex AI, and Amazon Bedrock model catalogs. (#57293) - Added codex queue --resume to resume unloaded threads after queueing a message. (#57232) - Added clearer safety-block explanations and selectable safer follow-up prompts in the TUI. (#57363, #57365) - Added codex doctor --network-only for focused configuration, connectivity, and WebSocket diagnostics. (#57606) ## Bug Fixes - Preserved acknowledged approval and permission settings when resuming or forking threads. (#57227) - Preserved local image attachments when restoring killed composer text. (#57502) - Fixed standalone release cleanup on macOS when installations are in use or paths contain non-ASCII characters. (#57503) - Restored spawned descendant threads when unarchiving their parent. (#57635) - Fixed app-server thread startup and shutdown races and released completed runtimes promptly. (#57787, #57788) - Improved TUI reconnection recovery, including offline /quit and /exit handling. (#57820) - Preserved reasoning-token accounting across resume and fork to avoid premature compaction. (#57839) ## Chores - Switched Bazel to source-built V8 with target-matched Rust bindings and native Windows MSVC archive support. (#57164, #57269, #57644, #57832) - Shipped the standalone executor in canonical CLI and app-server release packages. (#49353, #49880) - Explicit launch permissions survive terminal reconnects and new sessions, while implicit client settings no longer overwrite server or saved-thread web-search settings. (#49809, #49799) - Elevated Windows terminal sessions can start using an embedded server, and sandboxed PowerShell preserves relative paths beneath protected user profiles. (#49855, #49690) - Enter correctly submits buffered input after paste detection expires, including in Vim insert mode. (#49810) - Thread resume includes the latest committed history. (#49599, #49701) - Responses retries and WebSocket-to-HTTP fallback honor server retry guidance, reducing premature failures during overload. (#49441) ## Documentation - Authentication guidance now accounts for keyring storage instead of implying credentials always reside in auth.json.
